tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm cream in light, deep night navy in dark.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: mission cards, task card, feedback, admin forms.

tokens.name: panel-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: answer inputs, XP track, choice options at rest, the revealed-answer ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, choice options): 3:1+ on paper, panel and panel-sunk.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card hairlines only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, panel and panel-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, metadata, the translated line) on paper, panel and panel-sunk.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Brand hero red-coral. Primary action fill (one per screen), rank shield, brand moments.

tokens.name: hero-deep
tokens.usage: The 3D lip under a hero button and the rank shield's shade.

tokens.name: hero-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind hero moments (rank-up, mission briefing).

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `hero` fill.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Power yellow: XP fill, +XP stickers, stars, the current-step highlight. A fill, never text on paper.

tokens.name: volt-deep
tokens.usage: Shade side of volt: XP fill's lower edge, the lip under yellow stickers.

tokens.name: volt-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of hint cards and XP totals.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `volt` (always dark ink).

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Electric teal: 'power on'. Correct-answer fill (check sticker, border), success accents. As a fill with `on-spark`.

tokens.name: spark-text
tokens.usage: Correct-answer text (“Správně!”) on paper, panel and spark-soft.

tokens.name: spark-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the correct banner and a correct answer field.

tokens.name: on-spark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `spark` fill.

tokens.name: almost
tokens.usage: 'Skoro!' — wrong-part border, retry icon and text, on paper, panel and almost-soft. Orange, never red: a wrong answer is not a failure.

tokens.name: almost-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'Skoro!' banner and a wrong answer field.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and the pressed translation toggle's text, on paper and panel.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (3px): 3:1+ on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: on-color
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any subject colour fill (subject tiles, subject chips): always dark ink, both themes.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: bright blue. Default for Matematika.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: bubblegum pink. Default for Český jazyk.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: lilac violet. Default for Anglický jazyk.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: lime. Default for Přírodopis.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: sky cyan. Default for Zeměpis.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: warm sand. Default for Dějepis.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: mint. Spare slot for the next subject (e.g. Fyzika).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Categorical fill: peach. Spare slot for the next subject (e.g. Informatika).

tokens.name: subject-math
tokens.usage: Matematika. Subject tile, subject chip, the accent strip on its mission and task cards.

tokens.name: subject-czech
tokens.usage: Český jazyk.

tokens.name: subject-english
tokens.usage: Anglický jazyk.

tokens.name: subject-biology
tokens.usage: Přírodopis.

tokens.name: subject-geography
tokens.usage: Zeměpis.

tokens.name: subject-history
tokens.usage: Dějepis.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Dela Gothic One: a heavy poster face with anime-title energy. One weight (400, already black). Big moments and titles only, never paragraphs.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: XP gained, rank-up, mission complete: the celebration number.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: HQ greeting, subject page, mission briefing.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Subject names on tiles, power (topic) names, card titles, the rank name.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Rubik: soft corners, friendly but not babyish; clear Czech and Ukrainian diacritics, tabular digits for numbers.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: The task prompt in Czech, any subject. Big on purpose (laptop at arm's length).

styles.name: prompt-alt
styles.usage: The translated prompt (uk now, other locales later), in `ink-muted` under the Czech.

styles.name: answer
styles.usage: What she types in an answer field (numbers or words) and revealed answers; tabular digits.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Máš ještě jeden pokus. Podívej se pořádně na zadání.
styles.usage: Feedback text, hints, choice options, admin forms.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, admin table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers and chips; one or two words.

spacing.note: 4px base. Cards breathe: space-5 inside, space-6 between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, attempt pips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between answer parts and choice options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen margins at 1280px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Celebration screens.

radius.note: Round and bouncy: cards are big soft rectangles, controls are pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips' inner stickers, small tiles, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, choice options, hint cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: mission, task, feedback, subject tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels: HQ greeting, mission complete, rank-up.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the XP bar, attempt pips.

stroke.note: Borders are for controls; cards float on shadow.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Card hairlines and dividers in `line-soft`.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Input, option and secondary-button borders in `line`.

tokens.name: stroke-sticker
tokens.usage: Sticker outlines (in `panel`) and correct/wrong field borders.

shadow.note: Soft, layered card shadows plus a solid 3D 'lip' under pressable things — like buttons in a mobile game.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dialogs, the rank-up card.

tokens.name: lip-hero
tokens.usage: The 3D edge under a primary (hero) button; 2px when pressed.

tokens.name: lip-soft
tokens.usage: The 3D edge under secondary buttons and choice options.

tokens.name: glow-volt
tokens.usage: Rank-up medal and the +XP sticker: a warm power glow.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap, then 3px solid `focus`.
